hints.title: Row Level Candidate Selection
hints.text: Consider which elements from each individual row should be retained as potential candidates.

hints.title: Per-Row Limit Filtering
hints.text: Sort each row descending and keep only the top limits[i] elements from that row.

hints.title: Global Top-K Aggregation
hints.text: Gather all retained elements across rows, sort them descending, and sum the first k values.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.time: O(n * m log m + (n * m) log(n * m))
variables: n: number of rows in grid
m: number of columns in grid
complexity.notes: Sorts each row descending to retain row limits, then sorts pooled candidates globally.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all subsets across rows with cardinality constraints is intractable.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy per-row filtering reduces candidates before global sorting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply greedy row filtering and aggregate top global elements cleanly.
